g.text: PARTIAL SNAPSHOT · complete initial conditions 11/15; repaired 10/15
Only completed fifteen-problem conditions receive a validity fraction.
Denominator: all declared problems, including failures and unavailable responses; numerator: confirmed valid outputs.
Final validity includes unchanged-incumbent returns; 'changed' excludes them. Validity alone is not optimization.
Gray cells remain pending. An unavailable response is unconfirmed, not recoded as a compiler failure.
